prompt_template:
Simplify the news article using only facts stated in the article. Start with Summary: and follow this exact format:

Summary:
Write a concise summary in 2 to 4 sentences.

Aspects:
Event: Write one concise event description.
People: List the mainly relevant people, or Not stated.
Date & Time: List the relevant dates and times, or Not stated.
Location: List the relevant locations, or Not stated.
Effects: Write the effects, or Not stated.
Countermeasures: Write the countermeasures, or Not stated.

Use every label exactly once. Do not add, rename, or repeat sections.

Article:
{article}
